information:
There is no on-spot registration.
Please bring your ID cards for identification at the college gate.

We have a competitor limit of 130 participants which will be filled on First come basis.

Registration closes either on July 24th, 2018, 11:59 PM IST or when registration count reaches 130 (whichever comes first)
